transcript: Well, Minnesotans around the state have been raising the alarm with me that they are in some cases going dates without getting their mail delivered. Many of our post offices are for the first time responsible for delivering Amazon packages that once were delivered by FedEx or UPS. And what's really disappointing is that the Muckity-Mucksen, Washington, D.C., and the big post office leadership here just have not prepared our local delivery centers for this surge. And as a result, they're overextended and understaffed. And people are really missing out on getting the packages and the mail that they need. So I've been raising the alarm with the post office leadership here in Washington. Come to find out that, you know, the U.S. Post Service doesn't even really know themselves which routes are being mailed and which routes aren't. And so I'm working on legislation with Senator Klobuchar to fix that and also working directly with the Postmaster General to try to get some improvement in service for Minnesotans.
